website.error: LeMaitre is a peripheral-vascular medical-device company; corporate site lists product portfolio rather than a clinical pipeline.

ctgov.note: Only LeMaitre-sponsored P1-3 trial (NCT00131872, Expedial vascular access graft) is TERMINATED (started 2004). No active P1/P2/P3 studies.

commercial_product.summary: LeMaitre Vascular develops, manufactures, and markets niche medical devices for the open-vascular and endovascular surgical specialty. Product families include the XenoSure biologic patch, ProCol biologic vascular graft, AnastoClip vessel-closure system, Omniflow II biosynthetic vascular graft, embolectomy catheters (e.g., LeMaitre Pruitt occlusion catheters), shunts, valvulotomes (Expandable LeMaitre Valvulotome), carotid shunts, and the Aragon RestoreFlow allografts business. All are FDA-cleared/CE-marked marketed products, not investigational assets.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: TERMINATED — Expedial vascular access graft vs ePTFE (started 2004); program discontinued.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: LeMaitre Vascular is a peripheral-vascular medical-device company. Growth is driven by tuck-in acquisitions and incremental device approvals (510(k), CE Mark), not investigational P1/P2/P3 drug development. The single historical P2 device trial on file (Expedial) is terminated.
